response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of fullstack experience, strong depth in the core stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes), demonstrated testing and software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development), and directly relevant AI agent and MCP tooling experience. Gaps exist around Nest.js, Kotlin, and explicitly listed Vitest/Playwright experience, but these are learnable given the breadth shown, so an interview is clearly warranted.
strengths: Deep, long-tenured fullstack experience with the primary stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and AWS
Hands-on AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong engineering culture fit: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and community teaching/workshops
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned despite it being in the primary stack
Kotlin absent and Java experience appears dated/limited; Python not listed in skills
No explicit mention of Vitest, Jest, or Playwright, though testing expertise is evident in other frameworks

key_factors.factor: AI agent and MCP development experience
